text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 5098765432 - elevated 5xx rate observed for genqueue-usw (text generation). Affected: API endpoints in us-west-2. Auto-reroute and throttles engaged. Paging jamal (on-call) and ops lead.

jamal: ack, looking. Pulling SLO graphs now — will post impact summary.

maria: i'm taking comms lead. jamal — confirm customer impact & whether dedicated pools are affected.

jamal: initial scope: error rate ~12% for generation endpoints since 09:07 UTC. Spike affects ~18% of requests to hosted API in us-west-2. Dedicated/reserved capacity customers not impacted. No evidence of data exposure.

ops-bot: auto-reroute to fallback-model-pool triggered at 09:12 UTC. Latency +200ms while reroute stabilizes.

maria: drafting external bulletin (short-form). Suggest we keep it tight for status UI and a slightly longer customer email. Draft below (please annotate):

--- DRAFT (public bulletin) ---
We are investigating elevated errors for text generation in US‑WEST‑2. Some requests may fail or be retried.

Impact
- Affected: hosted text generation endpoints in US‑WEST‑2.
- Not affected: Dedicated/reserved capacities and embeddings.

Mitigation
- Traffic is being routed to a fallback model pool; error rates are decreasing.
- Autoscaling and throttles are active to protect backend services.

What you can do
- Retry requests; exponential backoff recommended.
- If you see persistent failures, contact support@redwood.com with request IDs.

Next update: within 30 minutes or when we have materially different status.

--- end draft ---

jamal: add a short line: 'No customer data was exfiltrated' only after legal confirms. Also include the approximate start time (09:07 UTC).

legal-bot: quick legal note: avoid firm ETAs, use 'investigating' / 'mitigating' language. If you claim 'no data exfiltrated' please confirm with SRE logs and infra team.

emily: i can localize to FR/DE once we freeze. Also recommend adding billing note: 'no credits applied at this time' unless post-incident review changes that.

maria: updated draft with legal phrasing and start time. New draft below: 

--- UPDATED DRAFT (public bulletin) ---
We are investigating elevated errors affecting text generation in US‑WEST‑2 since ~09:07 UTC. Some hosted API requests may experience failures or retries.

Impact
- Affected: hosted text generation endpoints in US‑WEST‑2. Dedicated capacity customers are not impacted.

Mitigation
- Traffic is being routed to a fallback model pool and autoscaling is active. Error rates are trending down.

Customer guidance
- Retry with backoff. If issues persist, send request IDs to support@redwood.com.

Next update: within 30 minutes.

Note: We are validating that there was no customer data exfiltration; we will confirm in a follow-up.

--- end updated draft ---

alex: LGTM, short and clear. Please add link to incident runbook and the monitoring snippet for transparency. After publish, ping #customers and CSMs.

maria: publish checklist (quick):
1) oncall confirms impact language (jamal)
2) legal ok on wording (legal-bot)
3) post to external bulletin UI + status endpoint
4) DM CSMs + paste FAQ snippet
5) schedule resolved notice once <1% 5xx for 10m

jamal: confirmed copy. Current error rate trending down to ~6% and continuing.

maria: PUBLISHING NOW -> https://status.redwood.com/incidents/5098765432 (posted external short bulletin).

ops-bot: External bulletin posted to status page. Monitoring set for 5m windows. Next automated check in 20m.

alex: preparing resolved notice template (short summary + root cause TBD + customer impact statement + credits policy).

maria: drafting a brief FAQ for CSMs to share: 
Q: Why did this happen?
A: A service-side routing issue caused increased failure rates. We're mitigating and routing to a fallback pool.

Q: Are my completions lost?
A: Failed requests should be retried; if you have missing critical outputs, file a support ticket with request IDs.

Q: Will I be billed/receive credits?
A: We're evaluating; at this time no credits are being applied. We will update if billing adjustments are recommended post-incident.

legal-bot: confirm we can state 'no data exfiltrated' once infra confirms.

jamal: infra checks complete — no data exfiltration detected. Confirmed.

maria: final note: we'll mark resolved after 10min of sustained <1% 5xx. I'll post resolve notice and short RCA pointer.

alex: thanks all. tagging CSMs & #customers after resolve. :thumbsup:
